Thought: The carbon NMR spectra shows signals at 167.15, 143.85, 130.30, 34.53 (twice), 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm. The signals at 167.15 and 143.85 ppm suggest the presence of sp2 hybridized carbons, possibly in an aromatic or conjugated system. The signals at 34.53 ppm (appearing twice) and lower ppm values are indicative of aliphatic carbons, likely corresponding to the methyl groups observed in the proton NMR. Given the symmetry suggested by the repeated chemical shifts, I will now validate the potential SMILES strings against this data.

I will start by validating the first SMILES string from the list of isomers: 'CC1=CCN2C1C=CC=C2'.
